purpose: Screen selected Batanes-locality type-series entries from the 2025 Philippine fish checklist as historical, voucher-linked marine evidence, without treating the checklist as a current distribution survey or complete local inventory.

source.title: An annotated checklist of fish species described from the Philippines
source.materialUsed: Main article text only. The article's separate supplementary species-list file was not accessed or used.

reviewScope.geographicScope: Selected type-series localities reported for Batanes, including Batan, Ibahos, Y'Ami, Siayan, and Itbayat vicinity.
reviewScope.habitatScope: Historical marine collections; source-record depths are shallow subtidal (0-18 m).
reviewScope.selectionMethod: Selected entries with named Batanes localities and, where supplied by the article, museum catalog identifiers, dates, or verbatim coordinates. This is not an exhaustive extraction of all Batanes mentions in the article.
reviewScope.coordinateHandling: Coordinate strings are retained verbatim from the article; no coordinate conversion, georeferencing, geometry, or map pin was created.

heldOutLeads.articleDisposition: The checklist equates this source name with Ptereleotris evides and states that all type specimens are presumed destroyed.
heldOutLeads.reasonHeldOut: No extant type voucher was identified in this entry; it is not included in the selected voucher-locality candidate set. This does not imply the taxon is absent from Batanes.

qualityAndReuseLimits: These are historical taxonomic type-series records reported in a national checklist, not a contemporary ecological survey, abundance estimate, catchability guide, or complete Batanes fish list.

A type locality or paratype locality is evidence of a historical collection label as reported by the article; it is not proof of current presence, population persistence, or a verified municipal-water boundary.

The article includes catalogue transfers, mixed-lot corrections, source-name synonyms, and collection-count errors. Preserve verbatim labels and voucher relationships pending individual taxonomic and museum-record cross-checks.
Only the main article was screened. Its CC BY 4.0 notice requires attribution; the separate supplementary species-list file has different ODbL terms and was not used.

Two catalogue lots were cross-checked against the Smithsonian's 1996 published NMNH type catalogue; no live specimen-portal record or API response was retrieved. The DMS strings remain source-reported values, not survey-grade or publication-ready coordinates.

The 1996 Smithsonian catalogue item page does not identify a reuse license in the reviewed metadata. Only concise, attributed factual notes are retained; no catalog page image or substantial text is copied.
nextAction: Check the selected checklist names against a current taxonomic authority without overwriting source labels, and continue Batanes freshwater source discovery separately because this historical marine type-series review adds no inland-water evidence.
